sequence_structure.prediction_description: At position 20 (second S5), predict T (position 0). Unlike standard LSC where T follows S5, here T precedes the source prefix, requiring a different retrieval mechanism.

token_construction: Sequences are token ID lists, NOT text. All tokens are word_en BPE tokens with Ġ (U+0120) space prefix baked into the embedding. Feed token_ids directly to the model. Do NOT re-tokenize. BOS is NOT included — prepend it at inference time if needed (e.g. TransformerLens prepend_bos=True shifts all positions by +1).
